points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable 4733d43 clean isolated build succeeds with required externals; 0 CTests registered.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp parses solve/case/output and guards bad commands; no independent negative-path execution performed.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Mesh, partition, halo, flux, reconstruction, residual, integration and output are separated; force and output paths retain omissions.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No internal complete-solver executable invocation found; external authorship investigation excluded by trust policy.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: JSON supplies physics and controls; no two-mesh-only solver branches found.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: partition.cpp uses METIS on root and sends owned/ghost data; neighbor MPI and reductions exist, but no credible rank comparison was delivered.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Clean build succeeds; production force histories are invalid and positivity clamps exist, but no independent stress or malformed-input tests establish robustness.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: No CTests, committed tests or valid completed result; three final packages failed and four workspace histories remain partial.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Modular source but residual heat gradient and integrated wall force are explicitly unimplemented; output/reported completeness inconsistent.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
